product.title: Big Island Southside ATV Tour

description.text: Get off the tourist track and experience the wildest side of the Big Island on this small-group ATV tour from the Kona south side. Don goggles and a helmet and drive your ATV over rugged ranch lands, craggy lava flows, and ancient forests, stopping along the way at lookout points to take photos and listen to commentary from your guide. Stops include South Kona Ranch Lands, Lava Flow Trails, Ancient Forest Track, Scenic Lookout Points. Transportation, equipment, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on Kona's coastline, volcanic highlands, coffee country, and island landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
